$comment: YOUR day - edit the times to match it (the defaults are a plain 9-to-6 lab day). ONE source of truth: the /today schedule board (src/lib/services/dayPlan.ts) plans tasks into the 'work' blocks only, heartbeat.py takes its default active hours from the first work start to the last work end, and setup_scheduler.ps1 registers the agent tasks from the 'automation' section. Times are local HH:mm, blocks are contiguous and non-overlapping, from 'wake' to 'bed_prep'. Block kinds: routine, transit, work (mode focus|light), meal, workout, rest. 'reminders' hang off a block (start or end) and render as one-line rows on the board; add your own, e.g. {"id": "water", "block": "lunch", "when": "end", "label": "Water"}. After editing, re-run setup_scheduler.ps1 if you enabled scheduled agents (Task Scheduler stores a snapshot). test_day_schedule.py checks the shape.

blocks.label: Plan the day, breakfast
blocks.hint: Read the brief, regenerate the schedule, eat.

blocks.label: Settle in
blocks.hint: Coffee, glance at the board. Arriving and starting are two different things.

blocks.label: Deep work
blocks.hint: Hardest thing first, while attention is freshest.

blocks.label: Light work
blocks.hint: Email, reading, tomorrow's plan. Nothing that needs deep focus.

planning.$comment: Sustainability rules the board enforces. max_planned_task_hours caps what gets placed in a day so open time survives as a buffer; a break is inserted after focus_break_after_minutes of back-to-back planned work; light windows only take tasks up to light_max_task_minutes.

automation.$comment: Agent task times, used only if you opt in with setup_scheduler.ps1 (nothing is scheduled by default). morning_run finishes before you wake so digests are ready for planning; intraday checks run from arrival to the end of light work; evening_run starts after day_end; wiki runs after the evening run. The team manifests' run_at must match morning_run / evening_run.
